units: <cite ref="Eruvin 40b">Erub. 40ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ש׳ רגלים</he>, v. <cite ref="T00204"><he>רֶגֶל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 41b:12">Ib. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ דברים מעבירין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00059"><he>עָבַר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 41b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ אין רואין וכ׳</he> three classes of men will not see the face of Gehenna (having expiated their sins in this world): those afflicted with extreme poverty &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 10a:5">R. Hash. 10ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <cite ref="U01385"><he>בן ש׳</he></cite> three years old (in its third year).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:10:2">Y. Succ. I, end, 52ᶜ</cite> <he>שְׁלָשְׁתָּן</he> all three of them.
Ex. R. s. 1527 שְׁלָשְׁתּנוּ all three of us; a. v. fr.—Pl. שְׁלשִׁים thirty. R. Hash. l. c. בן עשרים … וש׳ יום twenty-four months and thirty days old.
Nidd. 45ᵃ ש׳ יום בשנה וכ׳ thirty days of a year count for an entire year; a. v. fr.—Esp. sh’loshim, thirty days of mourning observances for a deceased relative.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 20a:16">M. Kat. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>נוהגת שבעה וש׳</he> the laws of mourning observances of seven days and of thirty days apply to it.
Ib. ישב עליו שבעה וש׳ he observed for him shibʿah and sh’loshim; a. fr.
